trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Proof block plus two italic scope paragraphs, read in full. All ten categories clean. The block-final 'The proposition closes the analytic existence question, not the regularization question' is a factual scope statement of what was and was not proved -- the documented temporal/scope false-positive class -- and the same holds for 'the convergence half ... that survives the refutation of the level-selection rule n_star'. RIGOR PASS, every step checked: |q^{-k}z| < q^{-k}*q = q^{1-k} <= 1 for k >= 1 is correct; sum|a_k| = |z| sum q^{-k} converges for q > 1; the uniform bound 1 - a_k >= 1 - |z|/q > 0 is correct since |a_k| <= |z|/q for k >= 1 and |z| < q; hence |g_k| <= |a_k|/(1 - |z|/q) is summable and the one-plus-summable criterion applies. The proof is complete and correct.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NUMERIC CONFIRMED, including the pin question. The scope note's 'Phi_q(0.989) approx 6.7e5' is CORRECT: evaluating prod_{k>=1}(1 - q^{-k}*0.989)^{-1} to convergence gives 671093.7 at the proton pin. PIN DISCRIMINATION: proton gives 671093.7 and muon 671092.6 -- indistinguishable at the printed two significant figures -- while the erroneous 1.1097 gives 695611.8, which would print as 7.0e5, so this figure DOES exclude 1.1097 while not separating the two live pins. One uses-hygiene note: the proof's prose cites conj:brane-tower-z-habiro and prop:mass-endomorphism-tower, neither of which appears in the block's uses[] (it lists only the parent proposition).
